items.title: Houston Person Part 1 interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995…

ctx.x: I would like to ask you as we wrap up our interview here, if you would have a word of encouragement or insight to younger or college age students, some involved in music, some perhaps at a liberal arts college, if you could give them some insights just about the nature of jazz or how to listen and appreciate the music. © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-
